citation.title: Functional characterisation of CD8+ T cells mobilised with acute supramaximal high-intensity interval exercise: implications for immune surveillance

reported.what: Venous lactate (mmol/L, mean (SD), n=7) pre, immediately post, 30 and 60 min after three 30 s all-out cycle sprints
Venous glucose (mmol/L, mean (SD), n=7) at the same four times; the pre-exercise state is a light breakfast of unstated content
Average power of the three sprints (the bout's only intensity), 595, 468 and 419 W, which is above 186 W (level 1) on the activity scale

location.quote: The average power (mean (SD)) for the three sprints was 595 (84) W, 468 (80) W and 419 (107) W for sprints 1, 2 and 3, respectively.

detail: The bout's printed mean powers (595, 468, 419 W; level = W/186 = 3.2, 2.5, 2.3) lie far above the activity scale's 0 to 1, the 2 min of low-intensity cycling between sprints has no printed power, and the pre-exercise state was a light breakfast of unstated content, so the pre-exercise glucose and lactate cannot be entered as a fasted value either.
